verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents an official MCP Server with hosted sandbox and production endpoints (https://mcp.checkout.com). It gives a concrete `claude mcp add --transport http` setup command with OAuth sign-in through the Dashboard account, and documented tools for searching docs and the API reference, querying payment status, refunds, voids and payment links. The probe confirms the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: the server is still labelled Beta, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as documented.
